popup.title: Akanamere
popup.description: The large freshwater lake, located in the [[Akanal]] peninsula, between the [[Akanapeaks]] to the north and the [[Maerthwatch]] to the south. The [[Blade Kingdoms]] sat on the lake's north-western shores, and a kingdom of friendly [[nixie]]s inhabited its depts.

popup.title: Nagawater
popup.description: The large, freshwater lake located in [[Sespech]] and named after a large population of [[water naga]]s that lived in the southern part of the lake.

popup.title: Methmere
popup.description: Also known as '''Lake Meth''' – a lake in the frontier between the nations of [[Chessenta]] and ]]Unther]].

popup.title: Lake of Salt
popup.description: Or '''Azulduth''' – a shallow body of water, fed by the [[River of Swords]]. It was surrounded by partially-looted [[Sauroid]] ruins, many of which extended deep under the earth and were primarily inhabited by [[yuan-ti]].

popup.title: Riftlake
popup.description: The large body of water in the middle of the [[Great Rift]], fed from the north by the [[River Shaar]] and from the south by the [[Rift River]].

popup.title: Bloodlake
popup.description: A small lake south of the [[Sharawood]].

popup.title: Lake of Mists
popup.description: The second largest freshwater lake in the [[Endless Waste]].

popup.title: Golden Water
popup.description: A bay located in the center of the [[Shining Lands]] and connected to the [[Great Sea]] through a narrow channel on its southern side.  The waters of this bay possessed a high mineral content, literally making them shine in the sunlight.

popup.title: The Throat
popup.description: A small bay in northern [[Var]], a natural shelter for several notable towns, including Var's capital city [[Pyratar]].

popup.title: Luirenstrand
popup.description: Better known as the '''Hambone Bay''', a bay and coastline in the [[Great Sea]] that formed one of the borders of [[Luiren]].

popup.title: Beastburn Lake
popup.description: A small body of water found in northern [[Dambrath]], where the [[River Ammath]] began its flow.

popup.title: Dolphin's Climb
popup.description: The river that flowed from the southwestern range of the [[Gnollwatch Mountains]], past the city of [[Herath]], and into the [[Bay of Dancing Dolphins]].

popup.title: Lake Lhespen
popup.description: A medium-sized lake found amid the sprawling plains of the [[Shaar]].

popup.title: Lake Maeru
popup.description: A small body of water found in eastern [[Halruaa]] at the foot of the [[Muaraghal Mountains]].

popup.title: Lake Halruaa
popup.description: The lake that dominated the center of the [[Halruaa]]n landscape, filled by the Rivers Halar, Maeru, and Aluar.

popup.title: High Aluar
popup.description: A waterway that originated in the [[Lhairghal Mountains]], flowing southeast where it merged with the [[River Aluar]].

popup.title: Talagath's Gauntlet
popup.description: Also known as the '''Straits of Suldophur''' or the '''Strait of Storms''' – a small strait that connected the [[Lake of Steam]] and the [[Shining Sea]].

popup.title: Scelptarmouth
popup.description: The mouth of the [[River Scelptar]].

popup.title: Lapalgulph
popup.description: A natural bay connected to the [[Lapal Sea]] via the [[River Lapar]], guarded by a monstrous [[dragon turtle]] paid by the [[yuan-ti]] of [[House Jennestas]].

popup.title: Thingulph
popup.description: A part of the [[Guthland]], the wide "mouth" of the large bay that dominated the center of [[Thindol]].

popup.title: Thornwash
popup.description: A 150 mi (240 km)-long waterway that flowed down from the [[Cloven Mountains]] and emptied into the [[Lake of Steam]].

popup.title: Lake of Steam
popup.description: Also known as the '''Arnaden''', an inland sea connected to the [[Shining Sea]].

popup.title: Gullet
popup.description: The perilous straight that separated [[The Tusks]], full of obtruding sea rocks – one of the most dangerous areas of the [[Sword Coast]] for marine traversal.

popup.title: Aumrauth
popup.description: A realm of [[aquatic elves]] located in the [[Shining Sea]] and stretching from the island of [[Tharsult]] to the mouth of the [[River Scelptar]].

popup.title: Lake Thaylambar
popup.description: The largest freshwater lake in all of [[Thay]], cold as a slaver's heart, and inhabited by huge herds of [[dragon turtle]]s.

popup.title: Lake Umber
popup.description: A freshwater lake at the base of the [[First Escarpment]] between [[Thay]] and [[Aglarond]], fed by glaciers of [[Thaymount]].

popup.title: Yal Tengri
popup.description: '''The Great Ice Sea''', was an arm of the ocean that covered the north pole of [[Toril]] with all sorts of cold-loving creatures found in its waters.

popup.title: Lake Mulsantir
popup.description: A lake connected to [[Lake Ashane]] via the wide [[River Mulsantir]] with its waters patrolled by [[Rashemi]] ''[[witchboats]]''.

popup.title: Vudlur
popup.description: One of the watercourses of the [[Esmelflow]].

popup.title: Splendarrllur
popup.description: Also known as the '''Shining River''' among the [[shield dwarves]]) was one of the three greatest rivers of [[Amn]].

popup.title: Lake Esmel
popup.description: A famous lake in [[Amn]], the largest freshwater lake in the [[Lands of Intrigue]] with the "Monster of the Lake" residing in its depths.

popup.title: Shimmalshyr
popup.description: A river that fed [[Lake Esmel]]'s southeast.

popup.title: Hyrzashyr
popup.description: A short river in [[Amn]] that fed [[Lake Esmel]] from the south, named during the existence of  the [[halfling]] kingdom of [[Meiritin]].

popup.title: Lake Weng
popup.description: A freshwater lake originally called the '''Lake of Amin'''. It was surrounded by small villages and fed by two rivers, eventually emptying into the [[Alandor River]].

popup.title: Wengwater
popup.description: A dangerously fast tributary of [[Lake Weng]] filled with deadly rapids.

popup.title: The Race
popup.description: A tract of water located off the southern edge of the [[Tethyr Peninsula]] in [[West Faerûn]] with merchant ships that sailed it being under the protection of the [[Calimshan]] navy.

popup.title: Nebulae Pool
popup.description: Or the '''Pool of Stars'' – a peaceful forest lake on the northwestern end of the [[Swanmay's Glade]]. A lone [[swanmay]] once lived on the lake but was belied gone or dead by the late 14{{th}} century [[DR]].

popup.title: Calathalureenteir
popup.description: The forest river that crossed [[Swanmay's Glade]].

popup.title: Impresk Lake
popup.description:
An ice-cold lake in [[Erlkazar]] fed by a large number of rivers and streams.

'''Note: This map shows the incorrect geography of the region. Please refer to 2{{nd}} edition maps.'''

popup.title: Khalleshyr
popup.description: One of the rivers of the [[Esmelflow]] and a major tributary of the [[Amstel River]].

popup.title: Lake of Snows
popup.description: A placid lake situated in the eastern reaches of the [[Giant's Run Mountains]], overlooked by [[Mount Dodild]] and the [[Breakback Pass]].

popup.title: Shalane Lake
popup.description: The northwestern narrow part of the [[Deepwash]] connected to the [[Impresk Lake]] via the [[Shalane River]].

popup.title: Lake Sember
popup.description: A medium-sized freshwater lake and the location of [[Hyaline]], an ancient [[sea elf]] city and the [[Crystalline Towers]].

popup.title: Wyvernwater
popup.description: The star-shaped freshwater lake at the center of [[Cormyr]], connected to the [[Dragonmere]] via the [[Wyvernflow]].

popup.title: Lake Eredruie
popup.description: An exceptionally beautiful pool fed by the [[Glaemril]] river, protected by the [[moon elves]] of [[Bristar]].{{approx}}

popup.title: Dragonmere
popup.description: Or the '''Lake of Dragons''', a large saltwater lake connected to the [[Sea of Fallen Stars]] with its shores belonging to [[Cormyr]], [[Sembia]], and the [[Dragon Coast]].

popup.title: The Warm Waterfall
popup.description: The waterfall that birthed [[Starwater]]s western tributary.

popup.title: Plungepool
popup.description: A pond of note in the [[King's Forest]].

popup.title: Redwater Lake
popup.description: The lake that was fed by the [[Lake of the Snake]] by means of the [[River Reddan]].

popup.title: Lake of the Snake
popup.description: A small lake on the [[Dragon Coast]], south of the [[Horse Prairie]] and east of the [[Giant's Run]].

popup.title: Lake of the Long Arm
popup.description: A vast lake found in the [[Dragon Coast]] region with the [[Shou]] nation of [[Nathlan]] located on its souther shores.

popup.title: Winding Water
popup.description: The river that flowed from several tributaries as far away as the [[Marsh of Chelimber]], and eventually flowed into the [[Sea of Swords]] south of the [[Troll Hills]].

popup.title: Misty Stair
popup.description: Waterfalls that birthed [[River Reaching]] in the [[Sunset Mountains]].

popup.title: Highstar Lake
popup.description: A legendary body of water located in the [[Delimbiyr Vale]], known for many mystifying appearances and mysterious disappearances.

popup.title: Whitewater
popup.description: One of the three tributaries of the [[Loagrann River]] that cascaded from the northern part of the [[Greypeak Mountains]].{{approx}}

popup.title: Lightless Lake
popup.description: Also known as the '''Moonmere''', the lake that hid the [[Fane of Shadows]] dedicated to [[Shar]].

popup.title: Arabel Springs
popup.description: The source of the [[River Arabel]], located in the hills just southeast of [[Arabel]] city.

popup.title: Lake of Drifting Stars
popup.description: A freshwater lake and a popular rendezvous spot for lovers who sought a romantic encounter during the [[Feast of the Moon]].

popup.title: Evenstar Lake
popup.description: The lake fed by the [[Alaoreum River]] in the [[Evenstar Vale]], surrounded by dense forests.

popup.title: Stojanow
popup.description: Also known as the '''Barren River''', used to transport ore and minerals from the [[Dragonspines]] to the cities of [[Phlan]] and from there – to [[Melvaunt]].

popup.title: Selpir
popup.description: A slow and quiet creek that forked from the [[Ardeep River]] and the [[South Ardeep River]].

popup.title: Lake Melishar
popup.description: A clear, cool lake in the middle of the [[Spiderhaunt Wood]] with the [[Nature's Inn]] perched on its shores.

popup.title: Lake Thentar
popup.description: A small lake from where the [[River Thent]] originated.

popup.title: The Bowl
popup.description: An open area of the deep sea found in the center of the [[Pirate Isles]].

popup.title: The Windrace
popup.description: A prominent strait that stretched roughly from the [[Bowl]] in the south to [[Alphar Isle]] in the north.

popup.title: The Spoon
popup.description: A small strait found within the [[Pirate Isles]] situated in the east and northeast region; it ran along the southern edge of the [[Alphar Isle]] and the eastern shore of [[Ilthan]] and bordered [[the Bowl]] to the south.

popup.title: Duathamper
popup.description: Also known as the '''Elvenflow''', one of two major rivers running through [[Cormanthor]], deep and wide waterway spanned by three black [[granite]] bridges.

popup.title: Pool of Yeven
popup.description: A small lake found within the [[Yevenwood]] in [[Battledale]].

popup.title: Glaemril
popup.description: Also known as the '''Deeping Stream''', a small river that started in the southern spur of the woods of [[Cormanthor]] at [[Lake Eredruie]] and flowed into the [[River Ashaba]].

popup.title: The Tunwash
popup.description: A minor waterway that drained into the [[Marsh of Tun]].

popup.title: Teerac
popup.description: A body of water of note in the [[Stonelands]].

popup.title: Lake Miir
popup.description: The lake where cities of [[Helvara]] stood with its waters inhabited by [[blue-scaled brench]] and [[spicy crabfin]].

popup.title: The Talons
popup.description: The forked tributaries of the [[River Delimbiyr]].

popup.title: The Sisters
popup.description: A set of waterfalls running over cliffs south of the [[Star Mounts]]; seeing the [[moon]] rise over the Sisters and glimpse a [[unicorn]] atop a cliff was considered a blessing of good fortune from the goddess [[Mielikki]].

popup.title: North Fork
popup.description: A shorter tributary of the [[Unicorn Run]].

popup.title: Starsilver
popup.description: A tributary of the river [[Delimbiyr]] and one of [[The Talons]], on which [[Myth Glaurach]], the City of Scrolls once stood.

popup.title: Lake Lemas
popup.description: A jungle lake connected to the [[Lapal Sea]] via the [[River Lemas]].

popup.title: Lake Luo
popup.description: An alkaline lake located in the [[Valley of Embers]] that fed the [[River Olung]].

popup.title: The Cauldron
popup.description: A bay located on the southern coast of [[Chult]], bordering the [[Land of Ash and Smoke]].

popup.title: The Suj-lan
popup.description: A deep bay on the isle of [[Suj]].

popup.title: Ice Lakes
popup.description: A group of frigid lakes in [[northwest Faerûn]] including: [[Derthym]], [[Belardym]], [[Rarghraum]], [[Loroloth]], and [[Antaerth]].

popup.title: Lac Dinneshere
popup.description: One of the three great lakes of [[Icewind Dale]] inhabited by the [[knucklehead trout]] and mysterious and elusive [[aquatic elves]], last seen in [[1281 DR]].

popup.title: Maer Dualdon
popup.description: The largest of the three in the region, with deep azure waters, the location of the barbarian [[Burial Isle]]. Its shores were settled by four out of ten [[Ten-Towns]].

popup.title: Redwaters
popup.description: Also known as '''Dellon-lune''', one of the three great lakes of [[Icewind Dale]].

popup.title: South Fang
popup.description: The easternmost part of the [[Easting Reach]], south of [[Cape Dragonfang]].

popup.title: The Old Water
popup.description: Sometimes called '''Cold Water,'''  a large frigid lake located downstream beyond [[Bluefang Water]], along the [[Great Imphras River]].

popup.title: Bluefang Water
popup.description: A large cold lake found in northeastern [[Impiltur]] that sat downstream where the [[River Icehilt]] joined the [[Great Imphras River]], just northwest of the [[Herald's Road]].

popup.title: Lake Icemelt
popup.description: A cold mountain lake near the [[High Pass]] south of the Earthwood.

popup.title: Luirbrech
popup.description: A lake of note.

popup.title: Lake Mereth
popup.description: The westernmost lake of the [[Teardrops]].

popup.title: Lake Muirenon
popup.description: The largest of the [[Teardrops]] lakes in [[Narfell]].

popup.title: Huta Lake

popup.title: Lake Musker
popup.description: One of the lakes of the [[Teardrops]].

popup.title: Lake Ashane
popup.description: Also known as the ''' Lake of Tears''', a large, glacial lake that formed the western border of [[Rashemen]], known for its smell of red [[juniper]] berries.

popup.title: Lake Tirulag
popup.description: An ice-cold lake that provided great natural resources and cultural significance for [[Rashemen]].

popup.title: Lake Flam
popup.description: A small forest lake of note.

popup.title: Lake Murthil
popup.description: A lake of note.

popup.title: Icelace Lake
popup.description: A huge frigid lake in [[Narfell]] that was created from runoff from the [[Great Glacier]].

popup.title: Galena Snake
popup.description: A winding river that flowed down the [[Galena Mountains]].

popup.title: Lake Mogador
popup.description: A crucial central location in [[Damara]] for both commercial and political reasons.

popup.title: Mirror Lake
popup.description: An icemelt lake northwest of [[Vaasa]], fed by the [[River Pelauvir]] and the source of the [[Beaumaris River]].

popup.title: Lake Midai
popup.description: A small but vital freshwater lake within the [[Bloodstone Pass]].

popup.title: Evermelt
popup.description: A subterranean hot spring found within a cave at the base of the [[Reghed Glacier]], a holy place to the [[Reghedmen]] [[barbarian]]s.

popup.title: Bloodmuck
popup.description: A lake in the land of [[Thar]], the source of a short winding [[Tormel River]].

popup.title: Ghost Lake
popup.description: A lake of note.

popup.title: Razack's Tears
popup.description: A long stream that flowed north from the [[Dragonspines]], wound across [[the Ride]] before turning northeast and joining with [[Telstang Brook]].

popup.title: Lake Maltorus
popup.description: A late in the center of the plains situated between the [[White Peaks]] and the [[Dragonspine Mountains]], fed by the waters of the [[Stoneshoulder Creek]].

popup.title: Lake Marjahon
popup.description: A small lake where the [[Solbudar River]] ended.

popup.title: Lake of the Leech

popup.title: Lake Sunder
popup.description: A freshwater lake located in northern [[Gnarhelm]], with the [[Farfair River]] entering its southwest shore and exiting to the sea on the northeast shore.

popup.title: Magglerak's Lake

popup.title: Lac Sielya
popup.description: A small freshwater lake of none.

popup.title: The Vasty Drink

popup.title: Lisloch

popup.title: Lake Otta
popup.description: A small freshwater lake of note.

popup.title: Hughloch
popup.description: A small freshwater lake located south of [[Hardangheight]], part of the [[Ironflow]] as it swept down from the mountains into the sea.

popup.title: Lake Hul
popup.description: A small lake along the [[Winterspear River]].

popup.title: Hot Springs
popup.description: Hot-spring pools of note.

popup.title: Taak Lake
popup.description: A small, fresh-water lake in [[Alpuk]] north of the [[Cold Lands]].

popup.title: Llewellyn Harbor
popup.description: A small natural bay, the location of the town of [[Llewellyn]].

popup.title: Straight of Alaron
popup.description: A body of water of note.

popup.title: Firloch

popup.title: The Wash
popup.description: A peaceful shallow bay named after its rhythmic waves rolling over the shores.

popup.description: A small clearwater stream named after a [[half-elven]] [[sorceress]] that lived there until [[127 DR]].{{approx}}

popup.title: Lammatar's Water
popup.description: A waterway of note in the [[Duskwood]].

popup.title: Myrloch

popup.description: Pirates' caves and coves of note.

popup.title: Mal Sul
